finalText:
I added a customer form with a Country field in `src/App.tsx`, plus a new `src/countries.ts` holding 195 country names. I haven't run it, type-checked it, or run `pnpm check`. I also didn't confirm that `field-error` exists as a class in the stylesheet or that `Combobox` and `Field` are exported from `@gener8v/ui`.

The Country field is a `Combobox`. Typing filters the list, and the arrow keys, Enter and Escape all work. It shows an invalid state with a "Choose a country." message if you submit without picking one. The form also has Name and Email fields, which I added as placeholders. Submit validates but doesn't save anything yet.

**Components used:** `Combobox`, `Field`, `Input` and `Button` (one primary button).

I didn't start from a design-system template, because none of them covers a single-field form like this.
